BiblicalUsage: The word hâdak carries the sense of to tread down, to crush. In Job 40:12, the text says "and tread down the wicked in their place."
TheologicalSignificance: I read hâdak plainly — it means to tread down, to crush, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
